expressionToTranslations.description:
An array of translation mappings based on expression matching.
Each entry maps a workflow expression to its corresponding banner text key prefixes.

title:
Global configuration for displaying workflow-related banner messages across the application.

This configuration provides an array of mappings between workflow expressions
and their corresponding banner text key prefixes. Each mapping defines how to match
a workflow ID using an expression and specifies the primary and secondary
banner text keys to display.

Each entry in `expressionToTranslations` includes a {@link WorkflowBannerTranslationEntry} object:
- `expression`: A string representing the matching condition applied to workflow IDs.
- `primaryKeyPrefix`: The prefix used to resolve the primary banner text.
- `secondaryKeyPrefix`: The prefix used to resolve the secondary banner text.

Example configuration:
```json
{
  "expressionToTranslations": [
    {
      "expression": "startsWith('asset-onboarding-export')",
      "primaryKeyPrefix": "Reliability.Banner.ExportData.PrimaryText",
      "secondaryKeyPrefix": "Reliability.Banner.ExportData.SecondaryText"
    }
  ]
}
```
